hints.text: Sort request destinations in ascending order.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Group requests into batches of at most capacity passengers traveling together.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: The number of rounds equals ceiling of total passenger requests divided by capacity.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def minElevatorRounds(requests: list[int], capacity: int) -> int:
    n = len(requests)
    return (n + capacity - 1) // capacity
```
